fee_notes: Base fee $49,500 for territory up to 50,000 people over 65; increases $1/person up to 10,000 additional people (max $59,500). 10% veteran discount on base fee. $10,000 discount on second unit purchased simultaneously. Development Fee: $49,500 for first unit + $39,500 each additional; 3-unit development fee = $128,500.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee ranges from $49,500 to $59,500.
